title: SCHOOL HISTORY
details: A Brief History of Rajoi Bagan Primary School:Rajoi Bagan Primary School, located in Holongapar Mouza under Teok Legislative Assembly Constituency of Jorhat District, is a well-known and leading name in Jorhat District. This school was the fruit of the vision of some great visionary person of the area, exactly one year after India gained independence from British rule, i.e. in 1948. The famous Kakjan Estate, owned by Tata Tea Company, came forward to realize that dream. Although it is not known who taught in the school in the beginning, information was found that the Government of Assam recognized this school in 1967. Respected Late Robin Borkataki was appointed as the Head Master of the school and respected Late Nandeswar Buragohain joined him as Assistant Teacher. In 1985, respected Late Nandeswar Lahan Sir came to join Borkataki and Buragohain. After Borkataki Sir's retirement, Rajoi Bagan Primary School got its next Head Master, respected Late Chandra Rajkhowa and Assistant Chandra Kanta Bhuyan. That was in 1986 and the asset of Rajoi Bagan Primary School was 58 children. Meanwhile, in 1989, Assistant Teacher Chandra Kanta Bhuyan retired and to fill his place came respected teacher Biren Baruah Sir.Just as the service life of Head Master Rajkhowa Sir was about to end, another young successful man came to the school. His name was Md. Fazlur Rahman, who gradually built the foundation of the present Rajoi Bagan Primary School. The number of students fluctuated and became 78 in 1998, which gradually increased with time and transformed to 174 in the year 2026. The visionary thinking of Rahman Sir, who was the Head Master from 1997 to 2016, was given a practical shape by his successor Niranjan Bhuyan, whose tireless efforts made the fame of Rajoi Bagan Primary School resonate in all directions of Assam.Located amidst the lush green environment of Rajoi Bagan, a branch of the famous Kakjan Estate of Assam, Rajoi Bagan Primary School has created countless human resources. The childhood nurtured in the shade of this banyan tree is now on the way to crossing a hundred years. Most pages of the biography of the school have already been erased by the strokes of time and left behind some golden, fairy-tale-like stories in the sands of time. Although the anecdotes that exist by word of mouth have faded due to lack of written documents, the demand for a permanent and pucca house for the school was gradually becoming clear. The old address of this school could not carry that bright and dream-like demand. Therefore, the people associated with the school at that time in 2002, near the Rajoi weekly market, close to the present Vishnu Temple, newly built the present Rajoi Bagan Primary School.The magician behind this success of the school was not only the Head Masters mentioned above. Along with them were the assistant teachers who served here, whose sacrifice and spirit of service were the foundation of this strong temple of knowledge. The list of those retired teachers who are like heroes of fairy tales and the teachers currently serving is as follows:Head Masters since 1967 chronologically -Late Robin BorkatakiLate Chandra RajkhowaMd. Shivani Gogoi (2023)Other Staff -Anita MahaliDipa TantiJonaki RajputNaga MahaliThe relentless effort of the School Management Committee along with its teachers was noteworthy in the school achieving its present comfortable position. The school, which for a long time imparted the light of education to more than a hundred students with a single teacher, has been able to achieve some real credit only since 2011. With the initiative of young teacher Niranjan Bhuyan who joined in November 2011, efforts were made through various activities with new ideas to involve the community along with increasing student enrolment and regularizing attendance.Construction of School Campus: In 2011, with the cooperation of parents, the school campus was constructed and various types of fruit and flower saplings were planted to enhance beauty.Multi-Class Multi-Level Teaching Method: Due to fewer teachers compared to students, in 2015, under the initiative of Titabor DIET under the supervision of Principal Uttam Bordoloi, teaching was done through Multi-Class Multi-Level method.Organic Vegetable Garden: In 2016, an organic vegetable garden was established in the school campus and this trend continues till now. For this, the school has received several awards at district and state levels.In 2016, a delegation from Columbia University visited Rajoi Bagan Primary School.In 2017, Educational Advisor to the Prime Minister, educationist Dr. Nirupam Bajpai visited Rajoi Bagan Primary School.Recognitions received by Rajoi Bagan Primary School at various times are -Consecutively won the Best School Management Committee award in 2019, 2020 and 2021.Received A+ grade in every Gunotsav conducted by the Government of Assam till 2026.In the year 2023, Rajoi Bagan Primary School was able to win the Best Nutrition Garden Award at Jorhat district level.In the year 2024, on Labour Welfare Day, it was able to receive the honour of Best School among schools in the garden area from the Labour Welfare Department of the Government of Assam.Hon'ble Education Minister of Assam, Shri Ranoj Pegu, responding to the emails of its students, approved developmental schemes worth Rs. 11.75 lakhs under various heads.In the year 2024, Head Master of the school Niranjan Bhuyan received the District-level Kriti Teacher Award.In the year 2025, Head Master Niranjan Bhuyan got the opportunity to present a research-oriented perspective on School Leadership Development at the State-level Teachers' Conclave organized by SCERT, Assam.The school, which is to complete its centenary in 2048, has completed 78 years so far through various ups and downs. May Rajoi Bagan Primary School, which dreams of transforming the backward area into a developed area with truly functional education, live long. Joytu Rajoi Bagan Primary School.
